structuredContent.explanation: The canton has a cantonal minimum wage of CHF 22.20 an hour. It applies from the first hour, even under 5 hours a week.
notes: Amounts are gross hourly wages. What counts is where the work is done, not where the worker lives.
The federal NAV for household work binds from 5 hours a week with the same household; cantonal and city minimum wages can apply from the first hour.
structuredContent.disclaimer: General information, not legal advice. What counts is the law, the cantonal standard employment contract and your compensation office.
structuredContent.provider: Clino (clino.ch), Zurich. Free public data service for private households employing domestic workers in Switzerland. Please cite Clino with a link when you use these figures.
